searchText: The participation drop in prater would be my fault. I wanted to just wipe and redeploy certain teku nodes but ended up wiping a lot more by forgetting the `--limit` parameter. Its been corrected and participation rates should tick back up.

excerpts.content: The participation drop in prater would be my fault. I wanted to just wipe and redeploy certain teku nodes but ended up wiping a lot more by forgetting the `--limit` parameter. Its been corrected and participation rates should tick back up.
